title:
A type to manage JupyterContent. We want a unified interface/API exposed even though the types and storage mechanisms
differ for different JupyterContent types.
For Jupyter content documentation, see https://github.com/ipython/ipython/wiki/IPEP-27:-Contents-Service
and http://jupyter-notebook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/extending/contents.html.
name: JupyterContentManager
